scope: current claims, methods, status, framework, metadata and workflows

units.normalized_content: Negative-Space Search v0.7 is frozen as an external-evaluation research artifact about search governance: when should a system expand its representation/search language after demonstrated inadequacy?

The strongest current claim is adaptive representational economy: boundary-gated generic synthesis preserves matched repair/invention quality while reducing unnecessary search and false expansion in the frozen synthetic benchmark.

v0.7 does not establish autonomous discovery, superior invention, primitive/meta-language invention, causal truth of generated predicates, unique negative-space mechanism, real-world interface invention, or superiority over strong generic synthesis/AutoML/LM baselines; no automatic v0.8 is licensed.

Supported claims concern non-identifiability-aware search control, representation-quality effects, conditional basis/language repair, and lower search cost from gating expansion after demonstrated inadequacy.

The repository explicitly withholds claims of unrestricted discovery, uniquely negative-space causal mechanism, primitive generator invention, externally valid causal concepts, real-world generalization, and better invention quality than matched generic synthesis.

The method stages increasingly hostile synthetic discriminators, freezes preregistrations/case matrices before implementation, separates search from update authority, preserves matched baselines, and carries negative/null results forward rather than repairing old tests in place.

Execution lineage distinguishes preregistration, implementation, CI/test execution, archived result interpretation, and later claim-boundary documentation; result summaries are not substitutes for raw or workflow execution provenance.

The current release preserves open failures/nulls: original unsignaled model-inadequacy localization remains unsolved, matched strong causal/generic systems erase negative-space-specific advantage, and v0.7 repair remains inside a supplied meta-language.
Later narrower successes do not retroactively close earlier stronger negative results; a negative result may be closed only by a new experiment that directly discriminates the implicated failure.

Documents editable installation, unittest execution, v0.1-v0.7 runner commands, expected v0.7 outputs, and provenance of the validated PR-state CI run while separating that tested state from the later archival release head.

Summarizes the staged executed results through v0.7, culminating in equal generated-operator quality/repair and representation cost for always-expand versus boundary-gated synthesis, with search cost 7800 versus 5200 and false expansion 1.0 versus 0.0.
The result summary localizes v0.7's advantage to when-to-search/search economy rather than what-to-invent/invention quality and preserves synthetic/supplied-language/external-generalization limits.
Defines the installable Python package metadata/version and build configuration for negative-space-search; package existence does not itself add empirical warrant.
Citation metadata identifies the software/research artifact and v0.7 release framing; citation metadata is provenance, not scientific validation.
Zenodo-style archival metadata describes the v0.7 artifact and narrowed search-governance claim; archive metadata adds no result independence.

Specifies the original matched causal-absence benchmark, hostile observational-equivalence control, baselines, metric vector and null; it is historical v0.1 scaffolding rather than the final v0.7 claim.
Defines benchmark-local absence/failure categories and explicitly limits them to controlled experimental organization rather than a universal real-world causal taxonomy.

Defines negative-space search as allocation of investigative attention over absences/model gaps while evidence, not search possibility, governs belief/update authority; emphasizes Psi != U and candidate != claim.
Mentions conceptual relation to Correctable Lineage as a scope/lineage statement only; no endpoint identity, resolved edge, composition, or authority transfer is established inside R37.
Freezes the v0.1 conceptual core including Psi != U, possibility != authority, non-exhaustive initial causal vocabulary, and the rule that model inadequacy is not an ordinary fifth cause.
Empirical failure should update the smallest identified component; failure of a benchmark mechanism does not automatically license expansion of the conceptual core.
Declares v0.7 frozen for external evaluation as an adaptive search-governance object, not a proof of autonomous discovery or uniquely negative-space intelligence.

Records equal invention/repair quality and representation cost for matched generic synthesizers, with boundary gating reducing candidate evaluations by one third and eliminating false expansion on the frozen v0.7 benchmark.

The primary null remains live; no v0.8 is automatic, and stronger claims require external reproduction, stronger matched baselines, corrupted/uncertain resolution, or a discriminator that attacks the supplied meta-language/generator itself.
CI installs the package, runs unittest discovery and executes benchmark runners v0.1 through v0.7 on push, pull request or manual dispatch; workflow source is distinct from a workflow-run record.
Release automation can create/publish v0.7 archival metadata and a narrowed result statement; release automation is not benchmark execution or independent validation.
